description:
Similarweb website traffic profile by domain: estimated monthly visits and change, global, country and category ranks, engagement (visit duration, pages per visit, bounce rate), site category and description, and company info. Figures are monthly; period_start and period_end give the month.

Operations (set "operation" to one of these; put its parameters in "args"):
- website_traffic_profile (required: domain): Website Traffic Profile

When to use: Use for a website's traffic, rank and engagement estimates. To scrape a site's contacts use website_contacts_scraper.

args.description: Parameters for the chosen operation as key/value pairs (see the tool description for required params).

operation.description: Which endpoint to call. See the tool description for each operation and its parameters.

name: realtime_similarweb_data
